name: Vegnar GFRP Rebar Bar
shortDescription: High-strength, corrosion-resistant GFRP reinforcement bars for concrete structures.
longDescription: Vegnar GFRP Rebar Bars are manufactured using high-quality glass fibers bonded with a durable polymer resin. These rebars offer excellent tensile strength while being significantly lighter than steel, making them ideal for harsh environments like coastal areas, chemical plants, and water-retaining structures. With complete resistance to rust and corrosion, GFRP rebars extend the service life of structures, reduce maintenance costs, and simplify handling and installation due to their lightweight nature.

reviews.author: Ahmed Construction Ltd.
reviews.text: Excellent corrosion resistance in marine environment. Much lighter than steel rebars, making installation faster.

reviews.author: Infrastructure Projects Inc.
reviews.text: Perfect for chemical plant construction. Non-conductive properties are exactly what we needed.

name: Vegnar GFRP Rebar Bend
shortDescription: Pre-fabricated GFRP rebar bends and hooks for structural reinforcement connections.
longDescription: Vegnar GFRP Rebar Bends are specially manufactured pre-formed reinforcement elements designed for structural connections and corner reinforcements. These bends maintain the same high-performance characteristics as straight GFRP rebars while providing the necessary shapes for complex structural requirements. Available in various angles and configurations, these bends ensure proper load transfer and structural integrity in reinforced concrete applications.

reviews.author: Coastal Engineering Works
reviews.text: Pre-fabricated bends save significant time on site. Quality is consistent and reliable.

reviews.author: Metro Construction
reviews.text: Good performance in foundation work. Custom bend angles available on request.
